hypothesis: Same-fiscal-period revenue guidance increases may precede residual returns in the issuer or economically linked firms over ten trading sessions.

sample.selection: Six named issuers selected for a cross-sector feasibility sample, not a representative or survivorship-free investment universe. Inspect all Item 2.02 8-K filings in each calendar release quarter. Select the earliest filing as an unverified candidate; retain all alternatives and require human verification of scheduled earnings release identity.

comparison.revision: For two comparable closed ranges, midpoint change and both endpoint changes. A strict raise requires neither endpoint lower and at least one higher. A crossing range is mixed, not a raise. No midpoint-percent calculation on zero or negative prior midpoint.
comparison.prior: Last guidance publicly disclosed before the current event for the same fiscal period; retrieve additional prior releases outside the sample when necessary. No annual rollover comparison.
comparison.consensus: Not an analyst surprise measure; historical consensus unavailable.
comparison.review: Exact current/prior passages and document hashes, independent verification, and explicit exclusion reasons required before a pair is eligible. Automated keyword windows are discovery aids only.

timing.policy: Neither filing date nor SEC acceptance proves first public dissemination. Historical source time requires corroboration. Unknown or conflicting times make the event ineligible; never backdate retrieval or decision timestamps.
timing.entry: First regular-session open strictly after verified availability plus declared processing delay; requires an exchange calendar and executable open-price data. Not implemented by this audit.
timing.exit: Close of the tenth exchange session counting the entry session as session one; five and twenty sessions are declared robustness checks, not optimized alternatives.

requirements: chronological splits with overlapping holding periods purged
portfolio cash/overlap/capacity rules frozen before returns
issuer and time dependence reflected in uncertainty
fresh forward records before any live-money consideration
evaluation.prohibition: This feasibility sample cannot validate profitability or select portfolio thresholds. Historical LLM extraction may contain pretraining leakage.
